name: House of European History
scope: The standing Eastman Building at the edge of Leopold Park, Brussels, including Michel Polak’s limestone former clinic and the contemporary glass House of European History extension.
era: The 1934–1935 Eastman Building after its 2017 conversion and three-level expansion.

originalReview.notes: Exact published Qualla exterior byte match. The photographer was the original own-work uploader, and personally released the unchanged file under CC0 in revision 668993616.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started from the published Qualla park-front view. Its exact bytes match the single native own-work upload, and the original photographer’s later CC0 relicense was explicitly verified. No image was copied into model textures.
